title: Rewrite etl4/vault/marts.py per-ym build (watermark-driven, partitioned writes, dim_* full-refresh)
objective: Rewrite etl4/vault/marts.py so the two large facts (fact_flight, fact_trajectory_enriched) build per-ym (filter on ym > watermark.get('marts','fact_trajectory_enriched'), write via vault_io.write_partition under ym=YYYY-MM/part.parquet, advance watermark.set('marts', <table>, ym, rc, conn) in the same psycopg transaction) while the two small dims (dim_aircraft, dim_airport) keep full-refresh monolith semantics. Add ym column on fact_trajectory_enriched from the state epoch via vault_io.ym_from_epoch so the body matches the partition name (architecture Open Question 5).
unblocks: T-22 (run_e2e pre-flight check -- needs marts partitions on disk)

files_changed.note: -118/+198 net +80. Removed: VAULT_DIR hard-coded path; _read helper (replaced by vault_io.read_table); _write helper (split into _write_monolith for dims + vault_io.write_partition for facts); monolithic build_fact_flight/build_fact_trajectory_enriched. Added: SILVER_VAULT_ROOT constant; DSN_DEFAULT env hook; _STATE_COLS / _FACT_F_COLS / _FACT_T_COLS schema anchors; build_fact_flight_for_ym; build_fact_trajectory_enriched_for_ym (adds ym column via vault_io.ym_from_epoch(df['time'])); _yms_to_process (drives on vault_io.list_ym('hub_flight')); build_marts per-ym loop with watermark.get at start and watermark.set in-txn for both facts after each per-ym write.

End-to-end smoke covering bootstrap + resume + watermark advance + partition layout + ym-column-matches-partition. Mirrors t08_vault_smoke's fixture approach (head(5000) of real monthly flightlists; T-08 build_raw_vault emits the partitioned vault; smoke synthesizes a 10-row sat_state_observation per ym so the fact_trajectory_enriched merge yields non-empty output). Snapshots + restores pipeline_watermarks for layers 'vault' AND 'marts' to avoid polluting the production registry.

contract_deviations: Task objective says 'Add ym column on fact_trajectory_enriched from the state epoch via vault_io.ym_from_epoch' -- implemented as df.assign(ym=vault_io.ym_from_epoch(df['time'])) AFTER the dim_aircraft merge so the merge never drops the ym column. By construction the derived ym equals the partition name because sat_state_observation was written with the same ym_from_epoch helper (architecture section 2.5 single-source-of-truth), but we re-derive from the epoch rather than carrying the ym column through the read -- this honours the objective text verbatim and defends against a future caller writing sat_state_observation without an in-file ym column.

Task mentions only watermark.get('marts', 'fact_trajectory_enriched') as the read gate; implementation advances watermarks for BOTH fact_flight and fact_trajectory_enriched after each per-ym write (two watermark.set calls in the same txn). Rationale: same pattern as T-08 (which advances watermarks for all 4 partitioned flightlist tables under the single hub_flight read gate). The read gate still keys on fact_trajectory_enriched alone per the task objective; symmetric write entries support rewind.py (T-21) which rolls back per-table watermarks.
spec_gaps_resolved: Task silent on the per-ym iteration driver when hub_flight has ym partitions but sat_state_observation does not (pre-T-10 state, or synthetic fixtures). Implemented: drive on vault_io.list_ym('hub_flight'); sat_state_observation read for that ym returns empty when the partition is absent; build_fact_trajectory_enriched_for_ym returns an empty frame with _FACT_T_COLS schema; vault_io.write_partition writes the empty partition; watermark still advances. On resume the empty partitions are gated by the watermark, not by the partition filesystem probe.

Task silent on dim_aircraft's data source during a per-ym marts build. Implemented: dim_aircraft is rebuilt ONCE per build_marts invocation (full-refresh, reads the globally-compacted hub_aircraft monolith), then passed as a frame argument into every per-ym fact_trajectory_enriched build so the enrichment is stable across all months in the same run.

Task silent on column pushdown for sat_state_observation. Implemented: _STATE_COLS = ['hk_aircraft','time','lat','lon','baroaltitude','velocity','heading','callsign'] matches the actual on-disk schema (reader_conversion_checklist.md section 1 row 9 listed 'icao24' but sat_state_observation does NOT carry it -- icao24 is enriched from dim_aircraft via the hk_aircraft merge). Documented as an in-file comment near _STATE_COLS.
